title: Wavelength history entry (one line of history/log.jsonl)
description: One revision of a Wavelength song, format version 1.0 (docs/song-format.md, Draft 2, section 6). I-JSON: no key twice in an object. Rules across lines (rev increasing, parent the revision before in the log, target naming an earlier revision, objects that exist and hash to their names) are checked by `wavelength validate` and scripts/wavelength_song.py. CC0.

rev.description: 1 for the first, and greater than the line before (writers add one; pruning leaves gaps).

time.description: RFC 3339. Also the git author and committer date.

op.description: Known values: save, render, undo, redo, restore. Readers treat an op they don't know like save.

parent.description: The revision before this one in the log (0 for the first); it may have been pruned.

kind.description: Known values: human, ai. Readers read a kind they don't know as human.

named.description: save entries: true when someone named the save point (it then has a message).

files.description: The full snapshot: every tracked path (the job and files whose role is source, notes or media) and the hash of its content, stored in history/objects/.

render.description: render entries: the hashes of the report and of the mix file the render wrote (not necessarily the file later kept in render/), and their loudness summary.

target.description: undo, redo, restore: the revision whose files were restored (the one that was current is parent).

hashRef.description: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits, as writers write it. A value with another algorithm's prefix is unsupported, not invalid (section 6).

path.description: Same rule as the manifest's paths (section 2).
